clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos dying in July 1989, within the year: your mother's worry over money beginning in March 1988 and her pulling away from talking with your father about it by May 1988, your brother Felix's grades falling in November 1989, and your mother's anxiety easing once she returned to work in March 1990. The shifts in your mother and brother fall close to his death and the months after, with your mother's earlier money worry and distance from your father sitting beside the same time.

clusters.name: Your mother Della told she had breast cancer, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother being told she had breast cancer in February 1995, within months: you developed migraines in March 1994, called your brother most nights beginning in April 1994, stopped returning his calls in June 1995, and stopped calling home in February 1996. Your diagnosis and your shifts toward and then away from your brother fall beside your mother's cancer diagnosis, with your migraines and the moves toward and away from your brother marking the months when your mother's illness was most present.
